messages.author: 2de7c33d05dd213b
messages.subject: updateRadioButtons(...,choices=NULL) fails to work
parts:
updateRadioButtons() doesn't work without passing "choices" parameter. I get the following error:
Error in names(choices) <- choiceNames : 
  attempt to set an attribute on NULL

Looks like a bug.

messages.author: 2de7c33d05dd213b
messages.subject: Re: updateRadioButtons(...,choices=NULL) fails to work
parts: Also updateCheckboxInput(session, inputId = "", ...) doesn't show any errors, but all other update functions, which come after it, fail. I guess it's the same for all update functions. Hardly anybody will forget to assign inputId a value, but updateCheckboxInput(session, inputId = "blablabla", ...) doesn't show any error messages either (I have no blablabla field), however it doesn't stop other updates from being executed. It makes it complicated to debug.

messages.subject: Re: updateRadioButtons(...,choices=NULL) fails to work
parts:
Hi,

What I do is save selected value to the database and then try to load it using updateRadioButtons(). I expected that I will be able to update only the selected value without specifying any other parameters, like the label that I don't have to specify, for example. So, I expect the choices to stay the same as in the original radio buttons object that I modify. NULL is the default value for choices and label in updateRadioButtons(), but I can skip label and cannot skip choices.

Dmitri
